name: Agora S.A.
summary: Agora S.A., a Polish company, primarily focuses on publishing a range of print media, including magazines, periodicals, and books. Its diverse operations are structured across five distinct segments: Movies and Books, Press, Outdoor, Internet, and Radio. The Movies and Books segment manages cinematic activities, encompassing film distribution, production, and providing gastronomic services. Within the Press division, Agora S.A. publishes both daily and special editions of Gazeta Wyborcza, alongside other periodicals, and engages in printing services. Its Outdoor segment provides advertising solutions utilizing various outdoor panels. The Internet division delivers online and multimedia products and services, primarily through its dedicated department and other related companies. Finally, the Radio segment operates a substantial network of local radio stations, including the super-regional news channel TOK FM, 24 Golden Hits stations, 4 Rock Radio stations, and 8 Radio Pogoda stations, broadcasting across 23 metropolitan regions. Beyond its core media functions, Agora S.A. also runs restaurants. Established in 1989, the company is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, and operates as a part of the broader Agora S.A. Group.
